scope: Read-only review of frozen Rina handler, current-top/shared-usage helpers, collector and scheduler for actual segment08 orientation choice; focused tests only, no discovery continuation or SOURCE edits.

findings.evidence: The current selected orientation consumes its shared OPT before _set_orientation. Collector sees a real own Veedramon Digimon suspension, then queues own BT11 Rina and inherited BT22 Aero together at depth3. Original return effect35 stays at depth2. Actual state/RNG before the saved failed command match the saved segment08 snapshot in focused tests.

dispatch copies selected pending into private _activated_pending and the handler verifies activated tuple, matching private id/effect/seat/source/field, current Tamer incarnation, exact historical trigger shape, owner/name and real orientation change. Valid private record accepted;10 malformed/unbound records rejected without physical-state mutation. Synthetic proof is saved separately.

None means decline with no cost/child effect. Already-suspended/cannot-suspend Tamer exposes only None and avoids parsing unreachable result text. PAY_NO_EFFECT is offered only with zero eligible effects and pays real Tamer suspension without child activation. If an effect is available, PAY_NO_EFFECT is rejected. This correctly separates optional payment from activating exactly one possible result.

Collector stores observed_instance and observed_source; resolution locates current top by the incarnation, not the old physical key. Focused tests confirm current top after evolution is used, while a newly incarnated same physical copy is excluded. The Rina source itself is separately bound to its own current entity.

current_digivolving_effects enumerates the registered current top and filters usage via the same keys used by original orientation/play handlers. Actual used orientation is absent, leaving [None,EX13-023.return_fewest]. No OPT usage is added by selecting the non-OPT return line.

Paid return is represented by a new sole eligible depth4 pending effect with private Rina parent id, paid source/entity and observed/current source proof. pending_options exposes only this depth before Aero depth3 or original effect35 depth2. Phase/control commands remain blocked while pending. This is a command-split representation of the nested activation; it does not create a second evolution or a simultaneous sibling. The tests retain original effect35 independently and return to Aero only after resolving/declining the nested return.

The handler only uses _set_orientation on Rina and queues one selected effect. The actual branch changes no zone, memory, RNG, stack, or OPT state while paying Rina; therefore it draws no card, charges no evolution cost and triggers no general evolution effects. Pilot routes only the offered result choices.
